以下为合成数学示例数据，仅用于演示界面交互，并非真实测量或统计结果。按当前默认值（a=3、b=1、启用偏移），x=5 时 y=16。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,result,chart,table,ask,reset], gap="medium")
$a: number = 3
$b: number = 1
$useOffset: boolean = true
let yAt5 = $a * 5 + ($useOffset ? $b : 0)
let points = @sample(x => $a * x + ($useOffset ? $b : 0), 0, 5, 6)
form = Form(children=[aInput,bInput,toggle], title="参数设置")
aInput = Slider(label="系数 a", bind=$a, min=0, max=10, step=1)
bInput = NumberField(label="偏移量 b", bind=$b, visible=$useOffset, required=true)
toggle = Switch(label="启用偏移 b", bind=$useOffset)
result = Metric(label="x = 5 时的 y", value=yAt5, unit="u", digits=2)
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"], title="y = a*x + (useOffset ? b : 0)", xLabel="x", yLabel="y", unit="u")
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x"},{"key":"y","label":"y"}], pageSize=10)
ask = Button(label="生成解释草稿", form=form, variant="primary", action=Ask(text="请解释这些参数如何影响函数 y = a*x + (useOffset ? b : 0)。", context={"a":$a,"b":$b,"useOffset":$useOffset,"yAt5":yAt5}))
reset = Button(label="本地重置", action=Reset(), variant="plain")
```
